flags.title: Sector tailwind
flags.note: Chemicals is in a TAILWIND (tailwind score +0.76) — the macro backdrop supports the setup.
flags.lesson: Focus on cycles and change, not insider chatter (the author's actual edge).

strengths.evidence: Technical score 100/100 - RS rating 100 (market-beating); +18% vs Nifty 500 (3M); above 200-DMA

strengths.point: ROCE runs well ahead of the sector median.
ROA runs well ahead of the sector median.
Promoters hold a controlling majority - skin in the game.
Relative strength is in the top tier of the market.
Chemicals is in a tailwind - the macro backdrop is supportive.
The 50-day average has crossed above the 200-day average.
The stock has beaten its benchmark over the past year.

weaknesses.point: The share price has run ahead of the fundamentals.
Institutional money has been flowing out.
weaknesses.evidence: NEGATIVE MONEY FLOW - institutional holding change -0.05 pp

opportunities.point: The company expects to commence commercial production of its grain-based Ethanol Project by September 2024.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Further, the Company has already initiated steps to establish grain based Ethanol Project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD and it is expected to commence commercial production of Ethanol by September, 2024." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

opportunities.point: The company expects sales and production to improve further in coming years while monitoring cost factors like inflation and energy prices.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "The sale and production has seen good improvement from previous year and it is expected to improve more in the coming years but it is necessary to carefully watch other factors such as inflation, high energy prices etc." (annual report - 2023-03-31)

opportunities.point: The company commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based ethanol plant and began commercial production in March 2025.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "The Company has successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based Ethanol Plant and commenced commercial production in March, 2025." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: The total project cost for the ethanol plant was initially assessed at Rs. 167 Crore excluding working capital margin, but experienced cost overruns due to civil work.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "The total project cost was assessed Rs. 167 Crore (excluding working capital margin) but the project was overrun due to Civil work." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: P/E is cheaper than the sector median.
P/B is cheaper than the sector median.
A chemicals tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Pasupati Acrylon anticipates sustained demand growth across its business segments.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Your Company anticipates sustained demand growth across segments." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: Demand for acrylic fibers is expected to rise due to macroeconomic development in end-use sectors.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "The demand for acrylic fibers is anticipated to rise in the coming years, particularly due to the macroeconomic development of end-use sectors which is supported by regional GDP and population growth." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: The annual production capacity for acrylic products stands at 42,000 MT.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "The production capacity to produce Acrylic products of the Company is 42,000 MT PA." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: In FY 2024-25, the company recorded acrylic fibre production of 35,198 MT and sales of 33,850 MT.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "During the year under review, the Company has recorded production of 35,198 MT and Sale of 33,850 MT, as against production of 31,534 MT and Sale of 31,685 MT respectively during the previous year." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: The company is continuously exploring new markets and increasing exports.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "The Company is continuously exploring new markets and increasing exports." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Crude oil price volatility driven by ongoing international conflicts impacted raw material costs.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The fluctuation in crude affects the raw material prices to some extent and during the year under the review, the crude prices remained volatile due to conflict in Israel-Hamas War & Russia-Ukraine War." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

threats.point: Ethanol prices are fixed by Oil Marketing Companies, leaving the company with no control over pricing.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The prices of ethanol products are determined by Oil Marketing Companies (“OMC”) and the Company has no control on the prices." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

threats.point: The absence of increases in Minimum Selling Price adjustments presents direct threats to forward planning and return on invested capital.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Additionally, the continued absence of non-increase in Minimum Selling Price adjustments pose direct threats to forward planning, capacity utilisation, and return on invested capital" (annual report - 2025-03-31)

swot.verdict: Opportunities dominate the evidence (S19/W6/O28/T12), led by 'The company expects to commence commercial production of its grain-based Ethanol Project by September 2024', so the case leans on things that are not in the reported numbers yet.
